composition.application_composition: Utility APIs and lifecycle consumers are authored; full source command/controller/server parent composition remains required by this milestone and later lifecycle owners.
composition.callback_owner: WebHook and APIServer source data own ordered handler/delegate collections. Closures retain only shared source data, avoiding mux -> bound owner -> mux Arc cycles.
composition.configuration_owner: CGP SourceClientConfigurationReader reads actual environment/files and returns Rusternetes wire configuration. Secrets use redacted Debug views. Relative paths, typed auth/exec data and empty config classification have native implementation; error/decoder/URL/platform profiles remain explicit gaps.
composition.crd_owner: RusternetesCrdContext owns HTTP client/base URL. The synchronous parent future owns each GET and poll timer and drops them on failure/timeout; no detached task or alternate orchestrator adapter.
composition.feature_owner: UtilityFeatureContext::feature_state owns one RwLock<FeatureGates>; M0001 state moves through into_parts/from_initialized. Existing core parser is reused, not duplicated.
composition.filesystem_platform_owner: NativeWatch -> selected v1.4.7 platform CGP provider -> owned native reader/resources/channels/completion, or the source Solaris construction error. Source pin imports gopkg.in/fsnotify.v1 1.4.7; earlier modern candidate mapping is superseded.

gateway_owner.codec: Fixed source UseProtoNames/EmitUnpopulated/DiscardUnknown behavior is consumed by serializer/decoder code, not stored as flags. Typed target preparation/decode retains source pointer, map, slice, byte and enum branches; shared first-value framing owns read-ahead and sticky read errors.
gateway_owner.metaprogramming: UtilityRuntimeContext and GatewayContext derive HasField + Deftly; UtilityRuntimeProviders/UtilityGatewayProviders supply static CGP factory, getters, codec, dispatch, callback and response implementations.
gateway_owner.routes: One GatewayState RwLock<HashMap<method, newest-first routes>> owned by the source factory. This source route table is data, not an effect registry. No global mutable descriptor/service/provider registry.
gateway_owner.schema: Each DynamicMessage carries its descriptor and linked pool. Any resolves its type URL against that pool. Full generated source descriptor/handler adoption remains explicit later work.
gateway_owner.tasks: Factory and codec spawn no tasks. Existing HTTP phase owns requests and connection drains. Callbacks borrow the active request; request return, response-body disposal and a dropped pending response head cancel its token. Normal server Shutdown does not cancel active requests early.

composition.http_owner: CGP/derive-deftly UtilityRuntimeProviders owns HTTP/TLS/clock/diagnostic/delay/log and SourceRequestBodyIo effects. RequestFields owns shared mutable method bytes, ContentLength and the current Body interface. The existing request/response phase separately retains one original transport RequestBody for response.reqBody discard/cleanup. ExpectContinue wrapper flags and its shared read/disable lock belong to that retained wrapper; H2 retains separate Continue state. SourceReadCloser is one per-request interface receiver, not a provider registry. SourceJsonDecoder retains one Reader and read-ahead buffer. Headers owns one shared byte-key map; HeaderValues retains slice bounds and shared backing. The existing SourceLogger serializes typed headers and original-byte strings. No task, competing lifecycle manager or general Go object layer is added.
composition.http_tls_owner: CGP/derive-deftly UtilityRuntimeProviders owns HTTP/TLS/clock/diagnostic/delay/log effects. SourceMux owns route data; listener/connection/request phases retain their existing resources. Headers owns one shared byte-key map; each HeaderValues view shares one backing array with independent source slice bounds. Response snapshots explicitly deep-copy. LogEntry retains typed header descriptors for the existing SourceLogger. Header data adds no task, general Go object layer, provider registry or lifecycle manager.
composition.logging_scope: UtilityRuntimeOwner retains SourceLogger/SourceErrorBackoff. LogEntry field copies retain typed shared Headers and SourceByteString original method/body bytes until the existing CGP emitter serializes. Source reader and HTTP lifecycle ownership stays in UtilityRuntimeProviders.
composition.production_package: Existing util workspace package; Cargo lib entrypoint is rust-support/agones/src/utility_lib.rs
composition.queue_owner: WorkerQueue owns locked worker/running counts and SyncHandler. SourceQueueContext owns one shared queue state and limiter instance. Queue actor/worker tasks live in the weak-referenced utility parent scope. Ready state and limiter state remain separate owners; Done and Forget are distinct. Stable heap nodes are shared by arena identity/map references rather than reinserting mutated keys.
composition.signal_owner: One SourceSignalState/Hub and common CGP subscriber select Unix sigaction/pipe or Windows console/atomic-waker Session at compile time. Each owns a process lease, subscription channels, reader and stop/quiescence/restore path. Terminal Windows callbacks are OS/process lifetime, with no captured Rust lease; actual application cleanup/exit remains M0027.
composition.task_owner: Root UtilityRuntimeOwner uses a reporting UtilityTaskScope with a bounded first-failure notification and original joined errors/panic payloads. Request-local HTTP scopes do not retain a growing failed-request history. Context/observer futures do not strongly retain their own supervisor; normal application cleanup cancels and joins. Actual production fatal/recovery policy belongs to the parent composition.

dependency_adoption: Native backend declarations retain existing root-lock HTTP/TLS/Tokio/JSON/YAML/base64/libc identities. comprende and better_comprehension reuse the already vendored first-generation sources; five exact package blocks (including clean-macro-docs/if_chain/syn 1) were adopted from the existing isolated CPG lock. Direct util dependency bookkeeping was authored manually, including base64 0.22.1 disambiguation. No resolver, compiler, formatter, macro/API probe or package execution ran. This continuation declares existing root errno 0.3.14 and regex 1.13.1 identities for signal-safe errno restoration and source install-hint Unicode category projection; only util direct lock bookkeeping changed. No resolver or executable assurance ran. Gateway adds prost-reflect 0.14.7 reflection/wire APIs only, with existing once_cell/prost 0.13.5/prost-types identities. One exact lock package was authored from the registry index/source archive without Cargo resolution. Optional serde/serde-value/ordered-float candidates were read but are not adopted. No new tool was installed. Platform continuation declares the existing root windows-sys 0.61.2 package only for cfg(windows), using the pinned FFI modules and existing futures/Tokio primitives. No package block/version upgrade, resolver or tool execution. No dependencies changed in this batch. The fswatch support selects pinned gopkg.in/fsnotify.v1 1.4.7 and adds its literal license; newer fsnotify 1.9 candidate semantics have no utility completion credit. This batch vendors the exact existing Hyper 1.12.0 source archive, preserving license/base file hashes and adding opt-in informational support in its existing H1/H2 drivers. Root Cargo patch/local lock source bookkeeping replaces that node registry identity without a version upgrade or Cargo resolution. Existing h2 0.4.20 informational APIs are bound to their original crate archive. No new tool/install/resolver or project execution.

HttpRequest and ResponseWriter share RequestFields for live method bytes, ContentLength and current Body. Mux, gateway method override, APIServer GET dispatch and HTTP response framing read that shared owner; pre-handler wantsClose/wants10 snapshots remain intentional.

SourceBody retains NoBody, native, H1 expectContinueReader, H2 reader, io.NopCloser(bytes.Reader), nil or one custom SourceReadCloser receiver. Cloning retains the interface receiver/cursor; replacing Request.Body does not mutate the retained original body or close the replacement during server cleanup.

H1 framing inspects current Body type/closed/remaining/expect-EOF state, but io.CopyN discard and finishRequest Close use the original response.reqBody. The final early-close type assertion applies only to the current native H1 Body, excluding expectation wrappers and custom readers.

SourceBodyRead retains data and an optional exact EOF/failure category together. Native known-length H1 reads pair their last data with EOF while holding the body lock; expectation EOF is set from that read result. H2 keeps its subsequent-read EOF behavior. Empty successful reads are not EOF.

H1 byte suppression and final length/reuse checks read the current Method; a previously selected chunked response still emits its final chunk after Method becomes HEAD. Source Empty headers use a native unframed body kept alive through the source phase, allowing subsequent Method reassignment without native length-zero truncation.
